note.label: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain

precepts.why:
“Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you”. We were forbidden to make marriages with the other nations. Deuteronomy 7 gives the reason: “For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.”

What happens if we do it? “Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land”. The nations you marry become snares and traps to you.

Look at the examples. A black woman who no longer thought she looked good as a black woman now looks like the Joker. A black woman doctor, and the best she could get looks like Quasimodo, the Hunchback of Notre Dame. A Kenyan woman vanished after meeting a 400-pound white boyfriend on Craigslist. Many of these women said the white man is better than the black man, and they were put to death. Black men too: a brother on Twitter spoke much evil about black women, and a white woman stabbed him to death, and she is home celebrating Christmas. Sherrone Moore already had a white woman at home, but needed a young white woman, gave her a six-figure job, and lost about 21 million dollars of his contract; he lost everything for a white coontang. Shannon Sharpe lost his ESPN role over a white woman he met, settling for millions. Halle Berry pays 8,000 dollars a month to that Edomite, who called her a nigger: he takes the money and says, Thank you, nigger, and walks away. That is a snare and a trap. God said do not do it.

Tobit 4:12 says the same: “Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”, for our fathers “all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children”. Look at the biracial children, so many confused and bugged out; it is rare when they know exactly who they are.

We had these laws from the beginning. In Genesis 6, “the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.” Before the flood we were called the sons of God. We went in unto the daughters of men, had children with them, and “every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” That is Psalms 82: “How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked?” We accepted the persons of the other nations, so we die like men, and fall like the other nations, and God will not drive them out while we cleave to them.

precepts.why:
“Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you”. Even when we took the land, there was a remnant of the nations left in the midst of us, and Joshua warned us not to cleave to them.

The warning goes on: “Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you”. Our forefather Joshua told us: marry these nations, and know for sure God will not get rid of them for you. We were warned to stay the hell away from these people, because their God is not our God. And we did exactly what we were warned not to do.

That is the reason behind Deuteronomy 7:3. “Neither shalt thou make marriages with them”, “For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods”. Look at it this week: Venus Williams married in Italy, and Italians are among the most racist people on the planet; do your history. Richard Williams put his life on the line for his black daughters to enter a space no one wanted them in; he protected them, provided for them, fought for them. The greatest thing a daughter can do for her father is bring home a man who honors him, and both of them spit in his face and married the same enemy their father fought against. This is the same man who was raping them, killing and whipping their fathers and mothers in front of them, abusing their children, and today they marry him voluntarily. And he would never have married her if the money were not there; remember what that white man did to Halle Berry. That is today's black woman society, and it is why God said do not make marriages with them.

precepts.text: Neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them, but cleave unto the Lord your God.
precepts.point: Joshua and Deuteronomy double it: neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them; and if thy brother or son or wife entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, thou shalt not consent. Wherever you are, do not go trying to find out how the nations worship their gods.

note.label: Exodus 23: Righteous Judgment, the Three Feasts, and the Angel of the Covenant

precepts.why:
Joshua doubles it: “Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left; That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them: But cleave unto the Lord your God, as ye have done unto this day.”

Making mention of the name of their gods is set right alongside swearing by them, serving them and bowing to them. It is the worship that is forbidden. Do not come among the nations to learn their gods; cleave unto the Lord your God.

precepts.text: The nations left remaining become snares and traps, scourges in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off the good land.
precepts.point: They are going to be problems, because they are not following the Most High as Israel follows; if you allow them to stay in your land they will always cause problems.

note.label: Numbers 33: The Journeys of Israel from Egypt to the Plains of Moab

precepts.why:
“But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.” Joshua repeats the warning at the end of his days: “Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.”

The nations left remaining are going to be problems, because they are not following the Most High as Israel follows. If you allow them to stay in your land they will always cause problems: snares, traps, scourges and thorns, until Israel perishes from off the good land.

precepts.text: Make no covenant with them, neither make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter take unto thy son, for they will turn away thy son from following the Most High to serve other gods, and his anger will destroy thee suddenly.
precepts.point: This is the same thing that happened at Baalpeor, when Israel went and mingled with the women of Moab and then worshipped their gods. The warning here is do not do that thing.

note.label: Joshua 23: Cleave unto the Lord Your God

precepts.why:
“Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them”. Joshua is repeating the law: “thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.”

The reason is given: “For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.” This is the same thing that happened at Baalpeor, when Israel went and mingled with the women of Moab and then worshipped their gods. That is why the nations left among you become snares and traps, scourges in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land. The warning here is do not do that thing.

precepts.text: As the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you, and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
precepts.point: When ye have transgressed the covenant and served other gods, ye shall perish quickly from off the good land. That is exactly why Israel is not at home right now; we did exactly that. And that is what the waking up is for today: the classes going out all day, the teaching in the streets, trying to bring our people back to the laws of God.

note.label: Joshua 23: Cleave unto the Lord Your God

precepts.why:
Joshua's words are heavy: “as all good things are come upon you, which the Lord your God promised you; so shall the Lord bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land”. Moses said it first: “And it shall come to pass, that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.”

Many come out of Christianity being told God is good all the time, yet the scripture says plainly that the Most High will destroy you when you go off, because that also is what he promised. Not one good thing failed, and the evil things will not fail either.

Plucked from off the land is exactly why Israel is not at home right now; we transgressed the covenant, served other gods, and did exactly that. And that is what the waking up is for today: the classes going out all day, the teaching in the streets, trying to bring our people back to the laws of God.

precepts.text: If ye make marriages with the remnant of these nations, know for a certainty that the Lord will no more drive them out, but they shall be snares and traps unto you, until ye perish from off this good land.
precepts.point: The nations were left without being driven out hastily, that through them the Most High might prove Israel, whether they would keep his way to walk therein as their fathers did, or not.

note.label: Judges 2: No League with the Inhabitants of the Land

precepts.why:
“I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died”. This is exactly what Joshua warned before he died: “Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you: Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.”

In the course of making leagues with the inhabitants, what else did we do? We made marriages with them, the very thing the warning named. So the Most High did as he said: he left those nations without driving them out hastily, that through them he might prove Israel, whether they would keep his way to walk therein as their fathers did, or not.
